description: This file defines the 'PerformanceTrackerReviewer' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. It maps the performance tracker reviewer data model to a database table, including properties like reviewer, performance tracker, added date, and status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the performance tracker module, including relations to reviewer and performance tracker, and metadata about creation date and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance tracker reviewer entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee entity who is the reviewer.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Assigns the Employee entity as reviewer.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when this review was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time when this review was added.
